## Level-up flow

**1. UI trigger** — `CharacterStateService.setCharacter()` (`frontend/src/app/services/character-state.service.ts`) runs `checkLevelUp(c)` every time character data updates (after actions/combat/etc.): `c.xp >= XP_THRESHOLDS[c.level]` and `level < 10`. If true, `_canLevelUp` signal flips true, and `character-sheet.component.html` shows the **"⬆ Level Up Available!"** gold banner (`@if (svc.canLevelUp())`).

**2. User action** — Clicking level-up calls `GameConsoleComponent.levelUp(ability)` (`game-console.component.ts`), which calls `GameApiService.levelUp(sessionId, characterId, abilityChoice)`.

**3. Endpoint** — `POST /api/levelup` (`worker/src/routes/levelup.ts`). Body: `{ sessionId, characterId, abilityChoice }` (one of `str/dex/con/int/wis/cha`). Server re-validates via `shouldLevelUp(character)` (same XP-threshold rule, level cap 10) before proceeding — returns 400 if not eligible.

**4. Character mutation** — `levelUp(db, character, abilityChoice)` in `worker/src/services/character.ts`:
- `level += 1`
- HP gain = `roll(CLASS_HIT_DICE[class]) + modifier(con)` (e.g. Fighter d10, Wizard d6, Rogue/Cleric/Bard d8, Ranger d10); `max_hp += hpGain`, `hp = min(hp + hpGain, max_hp)`
- Chosen ability score `+= 2` (no cap at 20 — known gap)
- AC is **not** recalculated
- Persisted via `updateCharacter` (whitelisted fields only).

**5. Side effects** — generates a narrative via `generateLevelUpNarrative`, logs a `[Level Up]` entry to `adventure_log`, appends to session history in KV, and returns `{ narrative, updatedCharacter, abilityImproved, newLevel }`. Frontend then calls `charSvc.setCharacter(updatedCharacter)` and `setCanLevelUp(false)`.
